dominant_breach: family-law conversion of household assets, retirement rights, support, and care into person-level wealth security
fastest_washout: divorce, QDRO, support, and care-recognition friction

intergenerational_transfer_gate.note: Household wealth is not person-level security unless divorce, retirement orders, support distribution, and care recognition actually convert it into usable assets for the claimant and child.

divorce_property_division_claimability.note: Property division depends on valuation, counsel, liquidity, enforcement, tax, and whether unpaid care or informal contributions are recognized. Rev0344 unused-source burn-down: World Bank gender-asset data is now bound to person-level family-property claimability. Rev0344 unused-source burn-down: World Bank women/productive-assets evidence is now bound to property-division and control burdens.

retirement_asset_division_qdro_access.note: Retirement-asset division requires plan-specific orders and execution; a decree without QDRO/plan compliance may not transfer wealth.

child_support_pass_through_to_family.note: Child-support collections count as family security only when distributed to the family in time rather than retained, intercepted, delayed, or offset.

child_support_debt_burden.note: Arrears, interest, fees, license sanctions, and incarceration risk must be separated into support for children versus liability traps for low-income parents.

proof_debt: QDRO and retirement division completion rate

gate_19_intergenerational_transfer.why: Comfort certification is blocked until the scoreboard proves claim conversion, notice, timing, legal aid or administrative capacity, vendor/report suppression where relevant, and subgroup outcomes at the actual threshold moment.

evidence_debt_register.question: QDRO and retirement division completion rate
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Collect rates of QDRO preparation, plan rejection, delay, nonexecution, and lost retirement claims by divorce type and representation.

evidence_debt_register.question: property division liquidity and enforcement
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Track whether property awards become cash, title, housing, or retirement control before threshold loss, especially for caregivers and lower-wealth spouses.

evidence_debt_register.question: child-support pass-through and distribution timing
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Measure collections distributed to families, retained for public assistance reimbursement, delayed by enforcement systems, or offset by arrears policies.

evidence_debt_register.question: support debt burden and sanctions
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Separate high-income avoidance from low-income arrears, interest, license sanctions, contempt, and employment barriers.
